pages.text: Matter crushed so dense that a handful outweighs a mountain. $(item)Neutronium Ore$() is found in the Tidal Depths (diamond pickaxe). Smelt the raw Neutronium into ingots.
pages.title: Neutronium
Neutronium as mass
pages.text: Fed to a stabilizer, a bomb or a Horizon Gate, or thrown into a black hole, Neutronium is worth far more than a block:$(li)Ingot: $(num)200$() mass$(li)Raw: $(num)100$() mass$(li)Block: $(num)1,800$() mass$(br2)A $(item)Block of Neutronium$() is so heavy nothing holds it up: it falls like sand and hits like an anvil.
$(item)Mass Shard Clusters$() grow on the islands, on top, underneath and on the sides. Each cluster gives a few $(item)Mass Shards$(), worth $(num)16$() mass each.
pages.title: Mass Shards

pages.text: Small gravity sinks on the islands: they pull in everything within $(num)7$() blocks, players too. Mine one for its $(item)Graviton Core$().
pages.title: Graviton Wells

pages.text: A speck of black hole slowly evaporating. It makes $(num)256$() RF/t on its own, forever, and pushes it into machines and cables next to it.$(br2)Made from $(item)Hawking Motes$() (see $(l:event_horizon/creatures)Creatures$()).
pages.title: Hawking Cell
Frozen Mobs
pages.text: Things from the overworld, caught mid-fall when the black hole swallowed them: cows, villagers, zombies, hanging in the air near the islands.$(br2)They don't move until you hit one. Then it falls, and if it was hostile, it remembers.
